title: Cultural Palette: Pluralising Culture Alignment via Multi-agent Palette

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cultural alignment and monocultural bias by measuring semantic consistency (using an NLI model for entailment probability) between LLM responses and culturally nuanced gold-standard values, and by calculating the Jensen-Shannon distance/KL divergence between LLM-generated answer probability distributions and real-world ground-truth survey distributions from the GlobalOpinionQA dataset.
